arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse, pickle

print('=== R1: letters format specifier ===')
r = parse.parse('{:l}', 'hello')
print(f'letters: {r.fixed[0]}')
r = parse.parse('{:l}', 'hello123')
print(f'letters with numbers: {r}')

print()
print('=== R2: __contains__ method ===')
r = parse.parse('{:d} {:s}', '42 hello')
print(f'42 in result: {42 in r}')
print(f'world in result: {\"world\" in r}')
print(f'named contains: {\"hello\" in r.named.values()}')

print()
print('=== R3: brace validation ===')
try:
    parse.parse('{:d', '42')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'Missing closing brace: {e}')
try:
    parse.parse('{:d}}', '42')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'Extra closing brace: {e}')
try:
    parse.parse('{{{:d}}}', '42')
    print('Escaped braces work correctly')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error with escaped braces: {e}')

print()
print('=== R5: Fortran floats ===')
r = parse.parse('{:e}', '1.5D+3')
print(f'Fortran E: {r.fixed[0]}')
r = parse.parse('{:g}', '1.5D-3')
print(f'Fortran G: {r.fixed[0]}')

print()
print('=== R6: hex/binary/octal auto-detect ===')
r = parse.parse('{:i}', '0xFF')
print(f'Hex auto: {r.fixed[0]}')
r = parse.parse('{:i}', '0b101')
print(f'Binary auto: {r.fixed[0]}')
r = parse.parse('{:i}', '0o77')
print(f'Octal auto: {r.fixed[0]}')
r = parse.parse('{:i}', '255')
print(f'Decimal auto: {r.fixed[0]}')

print()
print('=== R7: picklability ===')
p = parse.compile('{:f} {:d}')
data = pickle.dumps(p)
p2 = pickle.loads(data)
print(f'Pickled parser works: {p2.parse(\"3.14 42\")}')

print()
print('=== R8: findall case_sensitive ===')
results = parse.findall('{:w}', 'Hello WORLD')
print(f'findall default: {results}')
results_cs = parse.findall('{:W}', 'Hello WORLD', case_sensitive=True)
print(f'findall case_sensitive: {results_cs}')

print()
print('=== R9: left/center alignment ===')
r = parse.parse('{:<} world', 'hello       world')
print(f'Left aligned: {r.fixed[0]}')
r = parse.parse('{:^} world', 'hello       world')
print(f'Center aligned: {r.fixed[0]}')

print()
print('=== R10: slice access ===')
r = parse.parse('{} {} {}', 'a b c')
print(f'Slice [0:2]: {r[0:2]}')
print(f'Slice ::2: {r[::2]}')
"
